data.name: Rashaadah
data.gender_notes: Rashaadah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rashaadah means 'one who has good judgement, wisdom'. It is a unisex name and has its origin from the Arabic language. The name Rashaadah carries the meaning “Good judgement, wisdom” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Rashaadah usually hope their child will grow to embody good judgement, wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: This name is deeply spiritual as it refers to one who has wisdom and makes right decisions.
data.etymology: Rashaadah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Good judgement, wisdom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rashaadah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: رشادة
in_arabic.long_meaning: رشادة اسم مؤنث من الجذر الرشيد، يعني الهداية والرشاد، ومن معانيه أيضا الصواب والاستقامة على الطريق الصحيح، وقد وردت هذه الكلمة في القرآن الكريم بمعنى الهداية والرشاد، وهي من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني روحانية ودلالات إيجابية في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: رشادہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: رشادہ نام کا مطلب ہے هدایت، راست روی اور صحیح مسير، یہ نام عربی جڑ رشيد سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے هدایت کرنا یا صحیح طریقے سے چلنا، یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے اور اس کا استعمال جنوبی ایشیا کے مسلم معاشروں میں کیا جاتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: रशादा
in_hindi.long_meaning: रशादा नाम का अर्थ है हिदायत, सही रास्ता और सीधा रास्ता, यह नाम अरबी मूल रशिद से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है हिदायत करना या सही तरीके से चलना, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में प्रयोग किया जाता है और इसकी आध्यात्मिक महत्ता है.

in_pashto.name: رشادہ
in_pashto.meaning: لارښوونه، سم سته لاره، راسته لاره
in_pashto.long_meaning: رشادہ نوم معنی لارښوونه، سم سته لاره او راسته لاره ده، دا نوم د عربي ژبې د رشيد ريښې څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې د هغې معنی ده لارښوونه يا په سمه لاره روانېدل، دا نوم په افغان او پښتني دود کې روحاني او کلتوري اهميت لري.

in_english.name: Rashaadah
in_english.long_meaning: Rashaadah is derived from the Arabic root 'r-sh-d', which means guidance, right path, or righteousness. The name signifies leading someone to the correct path and is associated with positive connotations in Islamic tradition. It appears in Quranic contexts as guidance or righteousness, embodying spiritual growth and moral integrity.

It is believed that those bearing this name have been granted blessed with a keen intellect and good judgement, which they can use to make decisions that benefit themselves and those around them. Additionally, the name is said to be a reminder of the importance of relying on God's guidance and wisdom in all matters, as the Quran says, "And We have sent down to you (O Muhammad) the Book (this Quran) in truth, confirming that which came before it of the Scripture and as a guardian over it. Thus, the spiritual significance of the name Rashaadah is one that encourages continued learning, growth, and the pursuit of wisdom, while remaining steadfast in faith and obedience to God.
